I_loss from an index series

Source: R/iloss.R
calc_iloss.Rd

I_loss, the index value below which the stock is considered to deteriorate, from the biomass index of the rule. ICES (2025) defines it as the lowest observed index value, but stocks differ, and the choice changes I_trigger and the biomass safeguard, so the method has no default:

  • "min": the lowest index value.

  • "second_min": the second lowest index value.

  • "mean": the mean of the index in years (all of them must be in the index).

  • "fixed": value.

Missing index values are ignored.

Usage

calc_iloss(index, method, years = NULL, value = NULL)

Arguments

index

A data frame with the columns year and index, cut at the assessment year (see index_series()).

method

One of "min", "second_min", "mean" or "fixed".

years

The years of the mean (method "mean").

value

The value (method "fixed").

Value

A list with I_loss and year, the year of the index value used (NULL for the methods "mean" and "fixed").
